candidate_hypotheses.name: Strike-Steered Hydrothermal Upflow Plume x Smectite Clay-Cap Lateral Breach x Vent-Bridged Step-Over Mechanics
candidate_hypotheses.physical_signature: Upward-convex Hessian ridge and lateral gradient of log(1+cond_surf) co-located with short-wavelength RTP magnetite-destruction trough (G15(rtp)-G2(rtp)) and K/Th potassic alteration, coupled with strike-steered thermal/geochemical advection and Leave-Bucket-of-Components-Out (V-LBCO) vent-bridged relay corridors.
candidate_hypotheses.why_missed_by_catalogue: 75% of Great Basin geothermal systems are blind (Faulds & Hinz 2015), localized in concealed intra-basin step-overs and piedmont relay ramps lacking continuous subaerial scarps.
candidate_hypotheses.difference_from_existing_lanes: Prior lanes used either topographic step purity + Radon worms (H77-Step) or isotropic GDR Gaussians (H77D) without clay-cap Hessian ridges, RTP magnetite-destruction troughs, strike-steered thermal advection, vent-bridged V-LBCO relays, or uniqueness-constrained 300m submodular placement.
